doc.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014

title: Technology and recording length; setting up audio clips
summary: Rowe notes 78s versus LPs, then sets up a listening segment.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: It’s interesting how technology has affected things like, in the days when they were making records they were on 78s, they had three minutes to do their thing. And it affected the way they played I think. Because then the LPs, they said oh I’ve got 30 minutes on a side.

I want to make sure we’re — yeah, we’re picking up a nice vacuum cleaner here. Okay. I have a couple of audio things I’d like you to comment on if you don’t mind. This is not really what DownBeat would have called a blindfold test, but —
